predictCheckR: Bayesian Posterior Predictive Checking Utilities

Source: R/predictCheckR-package.R
predictCheckR-package.Rd

Provides a suite of utilities for Bayesian posterior predictive checking using the bayesplot ecosystem. Functions cover the full workflow: generating posterior predictive samples from draws matrices, computing predictive discrepancy statistics (Bayesian p-values, RMSE, coverage), producing publication-ready diagnostic plots, and comparing competing models via predictive performance metrics. Outputs are compatible with draw matrices produced by 'brms' and 'rstan'.
